name: Pražský okruh at Řepy, the cloverleaf by the Rudná exit
why: the survey of 30 September 2026 has one 4.4 ha carriageway with straight edges over the motorway, its ramps and the grass and trees between them, where IPR's photo shows a cloverleaf with grass inside; the map drew it all as asphalt

name: Národní over Divadelní's underpass by the National Theatre: the south pavement
why: the survey has the underpass's own floor as the ground here and the street over it on level 1; the game keeps the underpass as a tunnel, so the ground it paints is the street's, and the underpass's carriageway and pavements showed on top of Národní, across its pavements and tram tracks. As the survey's level 1 has this outline: pavement
